  make clean && make

Status:

    -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic

Smoke tests:
  ./demo_zombie_rampage
    - Loads INI from demo/rampage.ini.
    - Evaluates zombie/player, civilian/zombie, cop/civilian relationships.
    - Chooses zombie target from candidate list.
    - Fires death trigger.
    - Converts civilian to undead at runtime.

  ./demo_faction_war
    - Builds factions through API.
    - Evaluates faction matrix and tag rule fallback.
    - Chooses best targets for bandit and turret.

  No C++ line comments

Notes:

  The optional arena is caller-owned memory only.
